question:
The following table shows the sale of different brands of watches by a shop during 2014-2018.

 
 

 Year
 Brand (in thousands)
 
 

 Titan 
 Fastrack
 Timex
 Fossil
 
 

 2014 <
solution:
**Given:**

Sales data for each brand in 2017 and 2018:

Titan 2017 = 412, Titan 2018 = 288

Fastrack 2017 = 312, Fastrack 2018 = 202

Timex 2017 = 401, Timex 2018 = 255

Fossil 2017 = 146, Fossil 2018 = 126

**Formula used:**

Percentage Decrease = dfrac{(Previous Year Sales - Current Year Sales)}{Previous Year Sales} times 100

**Calculation:**

**Titan:**

⇒ Percentage Decrease = dfrac{(412 - 288)}{412} times 100

⇒ = dfrac{124}{412} times 100

⇒ ≈ 30.10%

**Fastrack:**

⇒ Percentage Decrease = dfrac{(312 - 202)}{312} times 100

⇒ = dfrac{110}{312} times 100

⇒ ≈ 35.26%

**Timex:**

⇒ Percentage Decrease = dfrac{(401 - 255)}{401} times 100

⇒ = dfrac{146}{401} times 100

⇒ ≈ 36.41%

**Fossil:**

⇒ Percentage Decrease = dfrac{(146 - 126)}{146} times 100

⇒ = dfrac{20}{146} times 100

⇒ ≈ 13.70%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2) Timex, with the highest percentage decrease of approximately 36.41% in 2018 compared to the preceding year.**
